items.q: What is missing from “just ask your agent”?
items.a: The gap between **one-shot working software** and software you would use every day. At Railway he folded site, changelog, blog, email, social, media, a **mini CRM**, tasks, and realtime editing into one app. He felt the breakthrough when **GPT-6** arrived.

items.q: Why does the codebase matter more than the language?
items.a: The agent **follows existing patterns** instead of inventing them. His defaults are **TanStack** on the web and **Payload** for content. He compared CMSs rather than building one.

items.q: Which daily-use patterns do agents skip?
items.a: **Non-blocking autosave**, block close on unsaved edits, realtime collaboration, **optimistic UI with rollback**, a short **undo** window, archive, **URL state** for filters, and **infinite scroll**.

items.q: What is the step after a green build?
items.a: A **computer-use loop** on the real infrastructure. The agent tries the feature **end to end**, fails, and fixes it. Passing tests still left **broken flows**. Opinions live in **three skills**: UI, animation, and Railway deploy.
